title: PlanRequest
description: Orchestrator -> Planner plan request. Sent via IPlannerPort.request_plan().

request_id.description: Unique request ID for PendingPlanContext correlation. Planner MUST echo this back in CommittedPlan.request_id.

intent.description: User intent extracted by Concierge (e.g. 'plan birthday party for Mom')

constraints.description: Budget, time, safety, and permission constraints for plan construction.

time_budget_ms.description: Max total execution time budget for the plan. Planner uses this for BUDGET-1 time estimation.

safety_band.description: Current safety band from SessionState. Planner must not select capabilities requiring higher band.

max_steps.description: Hard cap on plan steps. Null = use system default (50).

allowed_domains.description: Restrict capabilities to these domains only. Null = all domains allowed.

forbidden_capabilities.description: Capabilities the Planner must NOT include. E.g. user blocked a provider.

context.description: Routing metadata + optional pre-fetched SessionState snapshot.

tier.description: Always HIGH for PlanRequest (Planner only invoked for HIGH tier).

family_member_id.description: Which family member this plan is for.

snapshot.description: Optional pre-fetched SessionState snapshot. Planner may also independently read via query_planning_context().

timeout_ms.description: Max time Orchestrator will wait for plan. After this, PendingPlanContext expires and Planner is cancelled.

captured_at.description: Unix timestamp when snapshot was taken.
